evaluations.note: 19 since the HPO data hold the free energy and the Cauchy stress (2026-10-01; 18 before). BFGS reaches the upper bound RCUT2B = 6 at eval 9, re-evaluates it at eval 10, which comes out at the rounding level below eval 9 (the ~1e-13 relative re-evaluation noise of the warm-started lattice relaxation) and is the best (1.015561e-01), takes the one-sided gradient (evals 11-12) and re-evaluates the bound at eval 13, where the stagnation window (AFTER_STAGNATION 3) fires; each of the two RESTART rounds then stops after 3 evaluations without a new best: 13 + 3 + 3 = 19 (3 repeated runs identical).

status_note: Was COMPLETED: when RESTART used all its restarts and the last launch stagnated again, the journal fell back to the generic status. RestartPolicy now records why the run stopped; the window in the status is AFTER_STAGNATION.
tolerance_rationale: RESTART RANDOM seeds each restart from std::random_device, so the restart evaluations differ from run to run. Only values that do not depend on them are pinned: the best comes from the deterministic first launch, and each restart stops after exactly AFTER_STAGNATION evaluations because no start in the box beats the incumbent (see evaluations.note).
